This dashboard is an R Shiny app compiled to WebAssembly with
[Shinylive](https://shiny.posit.co/py/docs/shinylive.html). It runs entirely in your
browser — there is no server behind it. The app may take a few seconds to load the
first time.

::: {.callout-note}
## What data does this page contain?
Only a pre-aggregated, disclosure-controlled summary table produced at build time.
Cells with fewer than 10 respondents are suppressed, along with enough neighbouring
gender cells that a hidden value can't be worked out by subtraction. Published counts
are rounded to the nearest 5. Estimates are unweighted, matching the Results pages.
No individual-level records are included. See [Methods](methods.qmd).
:::
